articles.summary: MCP servers can create a credential governance gap that secrets storage alone doesn't close. This article covers where the authorization chain breaks when an agent is involved, and what a governance-first model looks like in practice.
articles.title: How MCP servers handle data privacy and security

articles.summary: Machine identities now outnumber people by roughly 144 to 1. Here is why human identity governance breaks at that scale and how lifecycle controls fix it.
articles.title: The rise of Non-Human Identities
